items.description:
Doors open at 5:30.

Bring:
- Tickets (on the fridge)
- Flowers for after the show
- A sweater, the auditorium runs cold

Parking:
The front lot fills up early. Use the church lot across the street and walk over.

After the show:
Pizza at Tony's with the cast families. Tony's closes at 9, so head over right after the bows.

Notes:
Photos are allowed during the curtain call only.
Please keep phones on silent for the whole show.
The show runs about 90 minutes with one short break.
